Method of Attack: Exploitation of insecure deserialization via Phar archives
Use of 'phar://' stream wrapper to trigger deserialization
Embedding malicious payloads in JPEG images
Attack Vector: Uploading a valid Phar archive containing malicious payload
Triggering deserialization through file operation functions like 'file_exists'
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious JPEG images crafted from Phar archives
